en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing a church. The main image on the left depicts the exterior of a Gothic‑revival style church with a tall clock tower, steep slate roof, pointed arch windows, and a stone boundary wall covered with vegetation. The top‑right image shows the church interior facing the altar: a chancel arch with decorative scrollwork, stained‑glass windows, side galleries with painted panels, and a carved altar with crucifixes. The bottom‑right image shows the rear gallery with a large pipe organ framed by Gothic arches. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the card.
